verification.explanation: Every register was matched against chapter 11 of the document named below: address, mnemonic, register title, bit ranges and bit field names come from the section recorded per register. Wording of descriptions was taken from the same source but has not been read sentence by sentence.

errata.summary: If a PLCA coordinator receives an unexpected BEACON, it sets UNEXPB in STS1.
errata.implication: The PHY then enters a recovery state and transmits neither packets nor BEACONs for the next two PLCA bus cycles. UNEXPB points at a second coordinator on the segment.

errata.summary: SLPCAL returns 0x0001 when read, but must always be written as 0x0000.
errata.implication: Writing back a value that was just read - from a read-modify-write or a bulk write - sets SLPCAL to 1 and can leave sleep mode unusable.

errata.summary: A PLCA coordinator does not stop transmitting BEACONs immediately when entering sleep mode.
errata.implication: A coordinator using inactivity-triggered sleep can detect its own BEACON as activity and wake again. Continued BEACONs can also prevent other nodes from entering inactivity-triggered sleep.
errata.workaround: Do not use inactivity-triggered sleep for a PLCA coordinator. Before entering sleep: clear PLCA_CTRL0.EN, set SLPEN, configure WKINEN/MDIWKEN as required, write SLPCAL as 0x0, and set SLPINHDLY to 1 or greater.

errata.summary: Periodic Event Generator output does not track adjustments to a synchronized wall clock.
errata.implication: If the wall clock is corrected by a clock servo, only the first pulse after REP is set is synchronous; later pulses follow the local reference clock and drift from the synchronized wall clock.
errata.workaround: To stay synchronized to the wall clock, trigger each event individually in single mode (REP=0) instead of periodic mode.

global_errata.summary: Packet transmission can halt after excessive collisions when one SPI transmit data block contains the end of one frame followed by the beginning of the next frame.
global_errata.implication: The device may stop transmitting Ethernet frames after an excessive-collision event. Receive frames sent to the SPI host are not affected.
global_errata.workaround: Ensure a valid PLCA configuration on the segment, since excessive collisions should not occur under PLCA. For pure CSMA/CD operation, consider limiting each SPI transmit data block payload to one Ethernet frame.

global_errata.summary: A PLCA coordinator does not stop transmitting BEACONs immediately when entering sleep mode.
global_errata.implication: See the s7 entries on SLPCTL0 and PLCA_CTRL0 for the full workaround.
global_errata.workaround: Clear PLCA_CTRL0.EN before entering sleep; never let a coordinator sleep on its inactivity timer.

global_errata.summary: Periodic Event Generator output does not track adjustments to a synchronized wall clock.
global_errata.implication: After the first synchronized pulse, periodic output can drift relative to the synchronized wall clock.
global_errata.workaround: Generate each event individually in single mode when synchronization to the wall clock must be maintained.
